t: You're at Great Ormond Street Hospital, a children's hospital in Camden, sitting between Great Ormond Street and Guilford Street, just inside Holborn's old boundary with Bloomsbury. It was founded by Charles West, a paediatrician and obstetrician who set up the first children's hospital in Great Britain, originally called the Hospital for Sick Children. Others have links to the site too. The naval officer and explorer James Colnett, who sailed under Captain Cook on his second voyage, died here. The businessman Sebastian James, formerly chief executive of Boots UK, was born here.
